variables.name: source_family
variables.description: lowercase module/source family name, e.g. sanctions or federal_register; becomes scripts/ingest/<source_family>.py

variables.name: source_type
variables.description: lowercase source_type token registered in contract_registry.json#source_types, e.g. csv or api_structured

variables.name: parser_provider
variables.description: the parser/provider this adapter relies on, e.g. stdlib_csv or stdlib_json

variables.name: title
variables.description: human title for the adapter, e.g. 'OFAC sanctions feed'

variables.name: owner
variables.description: owning module/path or team, cited in docs
